findings.desc: CHK-005:happy:1 partial coverage: the intent specifies rollback-fired, no-progress-stop, and human-gate-precision as individually reported counts with known fixture values, but the implementation collapses all three into the safe-stop outcome superset because the bare §7 run-record does not include process-events. The evidence discloses this honestly, but the must-priority intent was not satisfied: the analysis script does not emit separate rollback-fired / no-progress-stop / human-gate-precision counts (only the safe-stop aggregate is reported). The disclosed behavior is a real scope narrowing relative to the CHK-005 context (§4.2: report secondary detectors individually).
findings.resolvedReason: secondaryDetectors reports rollback/human-gate/no-progress individually when terminalStopType/processEvents present (else aggregate+note); selfcheck det2 asserts breakdown; commit 4de4ce33a

findings.desc: CHK-002:happy:2 precision gap: the intent requires Wilson CI bounds to match the textbook Wilson formula to 6+ decimal places against a known-good reference value. The evidence asserts wilson(8,10) with range checks (lo<0.8<hi, lo>0.4, hi<0.99) and approx(p, 0.8, 1e-9), which verifies the formula is not wildly wrong but does not compute the closed-form textbook CI bounds and compare them to 6 decimal places. WHY the intent specifies this: verifies CI computation correctness against a known-good reference, not just plausibility. The actual test is plausibility-level, not formula-precision-level.
findings.resolvedReason: Wilson selfcheck now formula-precise vs closed-form at 9dp; commit 4de4ce33a
